panels.name: Server Transfer
panels.title: Server Transfer
panels.description: Must be at least 14 years old • Able to speak english • An understanding of how 10-codes work and basic law enforcement duties • Must commit 4+ hours a week to maintain your LEO position You must provide a screenshot showing the server’s roles. You must have actively been part of the server within the last 2 months — applications from people who left or retired long ago will not be accepted. The server must be active and publicly released (not shut down or in development).
panels.welcomeMessage: Hi, Thank you for transfering our IAA team will be with you soon in the meantime send your roles from your previous server.

panels.name: Staff Report
panels.title: Staff Report
panels.description: If you have witnessed a staff member violate any rules within Discord or FiveM, they can be reported through this ticket! • Our Staff Supervisor team will only view these tickets. Any reports on Trial Management or higher need to be reported in the higher up report. • Clips/evidence is required so please describe the issue in as much detail as possible.
panels.welcomeMessage: Hi, please send proof of the staff member breaking the rules.
